caption: Trevi Fountain, Rome
composition: Baroque fountain facade in late-afternoon light · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands at the piazza edge facing the Trevi Fountain head on in the late afternoon. The travertine facade fills the frame: Corinthian columns frame the central arch, with Oceanus above the cascade and a niche and statue to either side. The attic inscription is carved into the travertine — CLEMENS XII PONT MAX, AQVAM VIRGINEM, COPIA ET SALVBRITATE COMMENDATAM, CVLTV MAGNIFICO ORNAVIT, ANNO DOMINI MDCCXXXV PONT VI — and the frieze is carved PERFECIT BENEDICTVS XIV PONT MAX, the letters carrying the stone grain and an incised shadow along the stone plane. Ochre palazzi close in on left and right, and the basin spreads across the foreground. The modelled scenario is 30 September 2026 at 16:23 Europe/Rome: clear, 26.6°C, cloud cover 1 percent, bright late-afternoon sun.
